components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call to action; full-width in stacked action groups, 44px min tap target.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; background: #d61450; color: #fff; font-family: 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; border: none; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #b30f43; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d61450; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #960d3a; }

components.name: Alternative Button
components.description: Secondary action in a stack: bordered white surface, no fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-alt { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; background: #fff; color: #111827; font-family: 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), border-color 200ms; } .ds-btn-alt:hover { background: #f9fafb; border-color: #d1d5db; } .ds-btn-alt:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d61450; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard text field on a surface; primary focus ring, red error state.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 42px; padding: 0 12px; background: #fff; color: #111827; font-family: 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius: 8px; transition: border-color 200ms, box-shadow 200ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6b7280; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #d61450; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(214 20 80 / 0.15); } .ds-input:disabled { background: #f9fafb; color: #9ca3af; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Content Card
components.description: Standalone surface for content/list items; border + faint resting shadow, no heavy elevation.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); font-family: 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-title { color: #111827; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-card-body { margin-top: 4px; color: #6b7280; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.6; }

components.name: Warning Notice
components.description: Calm tinted strip for offline/stale/connection states. Icon + text, same-hue darker text, full border (never a side stripe).
components.html: Нет связи. Показаны сохранённые данные — обновятся при подключении.
components.css: .ds-notice { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 10px 12px; background: #fefce8; border: 1px solid #fef08a; border-radius: 12px; color: #854d0e; font-family: 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-notice-icon { flex-shrink: 0; width: 20px; height: 20px; }

components.name: Bottom Nav Item
components.description: Mobile bottom-nav cell. Active = solid icon in primary; idle = outline icon in muted gray. State pairs icon fill with color, never color alone.

narrative.overview: FAN FAN is the entire anime festival, thumb-first, in seconds. The user is a tired teen between events, one-handed, on flaky con-venue wifi, looking up what's next or casting a vote. The interface gets out of the way: bottom-anchored navigation on phones, a left sidebar on desktop, a single scannable column capped at max-w-5xl, and generous 44px tap targets everywhere. The personality is clear, lively, calm-under-load. Vibrance comes from the watermelon palette — crimson-pink primary, cyan-teal secondary — and it is the only flourish; color does the emotional work in actions and states while the layout stays quiet, near-flat, and uncluttered. Surfaces separate by border and tonal layering, not drop shadows. It rejects childish/cartoonish energy, generic AI slop (no cream background, no tracked eyebrows, no gradient text, no identical icon-card grids), and clutter.
keyCharacteristics: One-handed, one-glance: bottom nav on mobile, sidebar on desktop, single capped column.
Color carries the joy; structure carries the calm.
Near-flat surfaces — borders and tonal layering over shadows.
Resilient by default: skeletons, cached-shell offline boot, calm error and stale states.
Light and dark mode, WCAG AA, full prefers-reduced-motion support.

rules.name: The Color-Earns-Its-Place Rule
rules.body: Saturated color appears only on action, active state, or semantic state. Inactive and resting elements stay gray. If a color is decorative, remove it.

rules.name: The Two-Layer Rule
rules.body: App background and surface are always one tonal step apart (gray-50 field / white surface; gray-950 field / gray-800 surface). Never paint a surface the same value as its background.

rules.name: The Inter-For-The-Job Rule
rules.body: Unbounded is identity, Inter is interface. Display type never appears in a button, input, table cell, or label.

rules.name: The Fixed-Scale Rule
rules.body: Type sizes are fixed rem steps, not fluid clamp(). A heading that shrinks in a panel looks worse, not designed.

rules.name: The Border-Before-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Separate a surface from its background with a border and a tonal step first. A shadow is only justified on something that genuinely floats or a tappable standalone card (shadow-sm). No shadow-md/lg/xl on resting content.

dos: Do keep every primary task one-handed and one-glance: bottom nav on mobile, >=44px tap targets, a single max-w-5xl column.
Do let color earn its place — saturated watermelon only on action, active state, and semantic state; gray at rest.
Do separate surfaces with a border and a tonal step before reaching for any shadow.
Do use Inter for all interface text; reserve Unbounded for the wordmark and rare identity moments.
Do pair every state with text/icon, not color alone (active nav = solid icon + primary; error = red border + message).
Do ship skeletons for loading, teaching empty states, and calm cached/offline notices — resilience is first-class.
Do write all user-facing copy in warm, plain-spoken Russian; keep code comments in English.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion and keep transitions 150-250ms, conveying state only.
donts: Don't go childish or cartoonish — no sticker overload, no comic-book energy, no talking down to teens.
Don't ship the generic AI template: no cream/sand body background, no tiny uppercase tracked eyebrow over every section, no identical icon-card grids, no gradient text.
Don't clutter — no wall of information, no cramming; one primary thing per screen with air around it.
Don't put a drop shadow heavier than shadow-sm on resting content; shadow-md/lg/xl are for floating overlays only.
Don't set interface text (buttons, inputs, labels, data) in Unbounded — display type in a label is a bug.
Don't use border-left/border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe; use a full tinted notice instead.
Don't convey state by color alone, and never use full-saturation accents on inactive elements.
Don't use fluid clamp() heading scales; type sizes are fixed rem steps.
Don't reach for a modal first — exhaust inline and progressive alternatives.
